|ingredients = {{Name|Blueberry|1}}{{Name|Wheat Flour|1}}{{Name|Sugar|1}}{{Name|Egg|1}} }} '''Blueberry Tart''' is a [[Cooking|cooked dish]]. It is prepared using either the kitchen inside an upgraded [[farmhouse]] or a [[Cookout Kit]]. Blueberry Tart may randomly appear in [[Krobus]]' shop on [[Days of the Week#Saturday|Saturdays]], in the [[Garbage Can]] outside the saloon, or in [[the Stardrop Saloon]]'s rotating stock. One Blueberry Tart may be received from opening a [[Mystery Box]]. ==Gifting== {{GiftsByItem |like=Robin,Demetrius,Maru,Sebastian,Pierre,Caroline,Abigail,Alex,George,Evelyn,Lewis,Clint,Penny,Pam,Emily,Haley,Jas,Vincent,Jodi,Kent,Sam,Leah,Shane,Marnie,Elliott,Gus,Dwarf,Wizard,Sandy |love=Linus |dislike=Harvey,Willy,Krobus,Leo }} ==Bundles== Blueberry Tart is not used in any [[bundles]]. ==Tailoring== Blueberry Tart is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] with [[Cloth]] in the feed to create a {{Name|Shirt016|link=Tailoring{{!}}Night Sky Shirt|class=inline}}. It is a blue dye when used in the spool of the Sewing Machine with a dyeable clothing item in the feed. It can be placed in the blue dye pot at Emily's and Haley's house for use in [[dyeing]]. ==Quests== Blueberry Tart is not used in any [[quests]]. ==History== {{History|1.0|Introduced.}} {{History|1.1|Reduced value to {{Price|150}}, down from {{Price|180}}.}} {{History|1.4|Can now be used in [[Tailoring]].
